section: Perspectives in Education · Ch — Teacher Empowerment
subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: A teacher regularly attends workshops, in-service training programmes, and peer-learning sessions throughout their career to keep updating their subject knowledge and teaching skills. This ongoing process is called:

options.option_text: One-time certification with no further training

explanation: Continuous Professional Development (CPD) refers to ongoing, career-long training and skill-updating for teachers, distinct from one-time pre-service training completed before entering the profession.
